stories.title: IIT Delhi opens applications for consultant roles
stories.summary: IIT Delhi is seeking six consultants for its Estate and Works Section, specifically for civil and electrical engineering roles. Successful applicants will receive between Rs 50,000 and Rs 80,000 monthly on a one-year contract. The institute may extend these appointments for up to two additional years.

stories.title: India Exim Bank to recruit 120 managers and trainees
stories.summary: India Exim Bank has announced a recruitment drive for 120 manager and management trainee positions. The application process opens on November 27 and closes on December 11, 2026. Interested candidates can submit their applications through the bank's official website.

stories.title: International student enrollment in US colleges drops
stories.summary: New international student enrollment at US universities fell 15% for the fall 2026 semester compared to the previous year, according to a survey of over 800 colleges. The decline follows changing visa policies and rising costs for higher education in the United States.

stories.title: US graduate enrollment for Indian students falls 34%
stories.summary: The number of Indian students in US universities fell 6.5% to 339,435 in the 2025-26 academic year, according to the Open Doors Report. The decline was driven by a 34% drop in graduate enrollments, marking the first annual decrease in five years.

stories.title: Indian student numbers in US decline for 2025-26
stories.summary: Indian student enrollment in the US fell 6.5% to 339,435 during the 2025-26 academic year, according to the Open Doors 2026 report. Despite the decline, India remains the largest source of international students in the United States for the third consecutive year.

stories.title: Indian graduate enrollments in US drop by 34%
stories.summary: Indian student numbers in the US fell 6.5% to 339,435 in 2025-26, with graduate enrollments dropping 34.4% to 116,609. While total enrollment declined, Indian students contributed an estimated $14.263 billion to the US economy and participation in Optional Practical Training increased by 26.8%.

stories.title: US international student intake falls 18%
stories.summary: The Institute of International Education reports that new international student intake in the US dropped 18% to 228,123. Indian enrollment fell 6.5% to 339,435, while Chinese enrollment declined 4.3% to 254,458. The US hosted over 1.1 million international students during the 2025-26 academic year.

stories.title: Indian student numbers in US fall 6.5 pc - The Hawk
Undergraduate enrollment for Indian students in US dips
stories.summary: Indian undergraduate enrollment in US universities declined by 1.1% to 39,711 during the 2025-26 academic year, according to the latest Open Doors report. This follows a broader trend of declining Indian student numbers in the United States, which fell 6.5% overall.

stories.title: US reports decline in Indian student enrollment
stories.summary: The number of Indian students enrolled in US universities fell to 339,435 in 2025-26, down from 363,019 the previous year, according to the Institute of International Education. Graduate student numbers saw the sharpest decline, falling 34% to 116,609.

stories.title: International Student Enrollment at U.S. Colleges Falls 3% as New Arrivals Decline - The EDU Ledger
Indian student enrollment in US sees first decline in five years
stories.summary: Indian enrollment in US universities fell 6.5% to 339,435 in 2025-26, the first annual decline in five years. The drop was primarily driven by a 34% decrease in graduate students, though India remains the largest source of international students in the country.

stories.title: Munira Akter Earns Medals at International Computing and Algorithms Olympiads - The Des Moines Register
Student balances dual majors at Vietnam Academy of Agriculture
stories.summary: Nguyen Thi Ha Trang has completed two concurrent degree programs in Technology Education and English Language at the Vietnam Academy of Agriculture. She maintained the title of Outstanding Student throughout her studies while balancing research and extracurricular activities during her academic career.

stories.title: British Council awards 64 scholars in Bangladesh
stories.summary: The British Council celebrated 64 students from 30 English-medium schools in Bangladesh for their academic performance in 2026. The awards recognized students who achieved the highest distinction grades in nine or more O level subjects or five or more A level subjects.

stories.title: 141 Bangladeshi students receive Cambridge awards
stories.summary: A total of 141 Bangladeshi students received 163 awards for their performance in Cambridge examinations held between November 2025 and June 2026. The recipients included 98 students who earned the Top in the World award for securing the highest marks globally in specific subjects.

University of New Hampshire students win biomedical research awards
stories.summary: Two students from the University of New Hampshire at Manchester secured top honors at the 2026 NH-INBRE Annual Meeting. Caroline Heafield won first place for her research on skin fungi, while August Paquin took second for his work using AI to measure pain in mice.

stories.title: Chemical engineering lecturer earns national leadership scholarship
stories.summary: Nicole Habbit, a lecturer at the University of Alabama, is one of three national recipients of the 2026 AIChE John C. Chen Early Career Leadership Scholarship. The award recognizes professionals who demonstrate involvement and excellence in the field. Habbit currently teaches multiple courses and assists with curriculum development.

stories.title: Eleven seniors named National Merit semifinalists
stories.summary: Eleven seniors at Latin School of Chicago earned semifinalist recognition in the National Merit Scholarship Program. To qualify, students required a PSAT index score of at least 223. The program saw 1.3 million entrants this year, with winners receiving monetary awards to support their college education.

stories.title: Eighth-grade student awarded $50,000 scholarship
stories.summary: Alyscia Vincent, an eighth-grade student in Lower Mills, is one of five recipients of the 2026 Inspiration Scholarship. The award provides $50,000 toward high school tuition over four years. Finalists were selected based on academic achievement, leadership, and resilience following interviews with the Catholic Schools Foundation.

stories.title: Limerick students receive entrance scholarships
stories.summary: Mary Immaculate College has awarded entrance scholarships to students for the 2026 academic year. The college released a gallery of recipients, including Brian Arthur, to mark the achievement.

stories.title: Teenagers develop salt-powered vaccine cooler
stories.summary: Three students from Shishukunj International School in Indore have created a portable device called Thermavault that keeps medical supplies cold for up to 12 hours. The cooler uses a chemical reaction between salt and water to maintain low temperatures without the need for electricity, batteries, or ice.

stories.title: World of Warcraft player exploits itemization for near-invulnerability
stories.summary: A player known as Rextroy has demonstrated a method to make a level 30 paladin nearly unkillable in World of Warcraft: Forever. The feat relies on new spellcaster itemization that shifts power from innate spells to gear. It reportedly took 20 minutes to solo a level 60 monster.

stories.title: Researchers fail to locate rare Fiji petrel
stories.summary: Scientists spent 10 days searching for the Fiji petrel, a seabird believed to number fewer than 50 individuals. While no birds were sighted, the team recovered a recording of the species' call. The bird's habitat and population numbers remain unknown to researchers.

stories.title: AI platform aims to gamify English study
stories.summary: Moti Malka, an AI architect, launched the educational platform YuviLab to help children practice English. The system uses AI to turn study tasks into games where correct sentence formation allows users to advance. Malka developed the initial concept to assist his son during school closures.

stories.title: Teenager builds voice-controlled home automation device
stories.summary: A 16-year-old developer has created a voice-controlled device capable of operating lights and fans without an internet connection. The invention, inspired by the fictional AI Jarvis, received praise from Biocon founder Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw after a demonstration video was shared on social media.

stories.title: Turkmenistan students win 13 medals at World Young Physicists Olympiad
stories.summary: Students from Turkmen universities earned 13 medals at the World Young Physicists Olympiad held in Bali from November 4 to 9. The national team secured three gold, five silver, and five bronze medals. The competition included participants from various higher education institutions across the country.

stories.title: Young Mathematicians Are Using AI Daily, and Most Say It Is Making Them Rethink Their Careers - Around Prague

University of Maryland professors navigate AI in classrooms
stories.summary: University of Maryland faculty are currently determining how to integrate AI into their courses. While some view the technology as career preparation, others express concern regarding its impact on learning. Current guidelines require students to disclose AI use, with unauthorized usage treated as potential plagiarism.

stories.title: Mendoza students comment on AI’s expansion in coursework and workplace - Observer Online
CBSE releases practice questions for Class 12 English
stories.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education has published 50 multiple-choice questions for the 2027 Class 12 English pre-board exam. The materials cover chapters from Flamingo and Vistas to assist students in developing reading comprehension and analytical writing skills ahead of final assessments.

stories.title: Biology practice questions published for 2027 pre-board exams
stories.summary: The CBSE has released 50 multiple-choice questions for the 2027 Class 12 Biology pre-board exam. The set is based on previous years' papers and is intended to aid student revision. The final board exam is scheduled for March 25, 2027.

stories.title: Maths practice questions released for Class 10 pre-board exams
stories.summary: The CBSE has compiled 50 multiple-choice questions for the 2027 Class 10 Mathematics pre-board exam. The set covers topics including algebra, geometry, and trigonometry. The practice materials are intended to help students improve calculation speed and familiarize themselves with objective-type questions before final board examinations.

stories.title: ICSE releases Class 10 Computer Applications exam pattern for 2027
stories.summary: The CISCE has published the exam structure for the 2026-27 Computer Applications course. The subject is classified under Group III, with the final grade split evenly between an external written examination and internal assessments. Students can now review the marking scheme and passing criteria for the 2027 board exams.

stories.title: University of Strathclyde offers six Commonwealth scholarships
stories.summary: The University of Strathclyde and the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission are offering six fully funded Master's scholarships for students from least developed and lower-middle-income Commonwealth countries. The program aims to support academic excellence and contributions to sustainable development. Applications are open for the 2027 academic year.

stories.title: Birmingham Newman University announces GREAT scholarships for 2026
stories.summary: Birmingham Newman University is offering scholarships of at least £10,000 to students from Ghana and Nigeria for one-year Master's programs. The initiative is run in partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign. Eligible students must apply for the 2026-27 academic year.

stories.title: International scholarship deadlines approaching for 2027
stories.summary: Several institutions have updated their scholarship deadlines for the 2027 academic year. Opportunities include fellowships at EPFL, merit-based awards at Politecnico di Milano, and stipend scholarships at the University of Sydney. Most application windows for these programs close between December 2026 and September 2027.

stories.title: 5 Best SAT Prep Courses: Which One Is for You? - Charlotte Observer
Early decision is a commitment, not a shortcut
stories.summary: Early decision programs are designed for students who have identified a single college as their clear first choice. Experts suggest that applicants should confirm their family's financial situation before committing, as early decision functions as a binding agreement rather than a strategic advantage for admission.

stories.title: CAT 2026 strategy emphasizes question selection
stories.summary: With the CAT 2026 exam scheduled for November 29, candidates are advised to prioritize question selection over total volume. Success depends on managing time and taking calculated risks under pressure. The exam requires students to optimize their performance by identifying which questions to avoid.

stories.title: RMO 2026 expected cutoff scores released
stories.summary: Physics Wallah has published anticipated score ranges for the 2026 Regional Mathematical Olympiad. The estimates are broken down by region and category, including separate brackets for female students and different grade levels. Candidates may use these projections to evaluate their performance against regional trends.

stories.title: Jay Kennedy Memorial Scholarship applications open
stories.summary: The National Cartoonists Society Foundation is accepting applications for the 2026 Jay Kennedy Memorial Scholarship. Eligible students at four-year colleges in the United States, Mexico, or Canada must submit eight samples of their published work. The deadline for all submissions is December 21.

stories.title: Woxsen University students win national project and hackathon prizes
stories.summary: Students from Woxsen University's School of Technology secured top honors at two national competitions in October 2026. The team won second prize at the Pragathi Project Expo 2.0 for an autonomous water quality monitoring platform. The university also reported success at the Tri-City AI Hackathon.

stories.title: Emerald Heights to host All India IPSC Cricket Competition
stories.summary: Emerald Heights International School will host the All India IPSC Cricket Competition from November 18 to 23. The tournament features boys' Under-17 teams from 13 schools across India. Approximately 200 players are expected to participate in the six-day event in Indore.

stories.title: WION hosts golf invitational in New Delhi
stories.summary: WION held its World Is One Golf Invitational on November 14 at the Qutab Golf Course. The event brought together 115 participants, including diplomats and corporate leaders, to mark the network's 10-year anniversary. Shrewsbury International School India served as the education partner for the gathering.

stories.title: INSPIRE SHE Scholarship 2026 Application Begins, Check Steps, Eligibility and Benefits - Telegraph India
SC students can apply for Top Class Education Scheme
stories.summary: The Central Government is accepting applications for the Top Class Education Scheme for the 2026-27 academic year. Students from Scheduled Caste communities pursuing higher education at notified institutions must submit their applications via the National Scholarship Portal by November 30.

stories.title: Six scholarship programs available for Indian students
stories.summary: Various scholarship programs are currently accepting applications for the 2026-27 academic year. Benefits include financial assistance up to ₹75,000 and fully funded coaching for competitive exams like JEE and CAT. The programs target students in professional courses, including engineering and dentistry.

stories.summary: The Telangana Board of Intermediate Education has announced that November 30 is the final date for fresh and renewal applications for the National Merit Scholarship. Students who passed the 2026 Intermediate Public Examination are eligible to apply. Verification for the scheme must be completed by December 15.

stories.title: DST opens applications for 12,000 INSPIRE scholarships
stories.summary: The Department of Science and Technology has opened applications for 12,000 INSPIRE scholarships for students in basic and natural sciences. The department says it has revised the framework to improve implementation and inclusivity. Applications for the 2026 programme remain open until December 7, 2026.

stories.title: INSPIRE-SHE scholarship applications open for 12,000 students
stories.summary: The Department of Science and Technology is accepting applications for 12,000 scholarships for students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate science courses. Eligible candidates who passed Class 12 in 2025 can apply via the official portal. The window closes on December 7, 2026, at 11:59 pm.

stories.title: DST invites applications for 12,000 science scholarships
stories.summary: The Department of Science and Technology has invited applications for 12,000 INSPIRE-SHE scholarships for the 2025 batch of science students. Interested candidates must submit their applications online by December 7, 2026. The programme is intended for students pursuing courses in basic and natural sciences.

stories.title: SMACNA opens college scholarship applications for 2027-28
stories.summary: The Sheet Metal and Air Conditioning Contractors' National Association has opened scholarship applications for the 2027-28 academic year. The programme is open to full-time students at accredited four-year colleges, with preference given to those pursuing careers connected to the sheet metal industry.

stories.title: UGC offers postgraduate scholarships for 2026
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission is offering financial assistance to postgraduate students, including law graduates. Selected students receive 15,000 rupees per month for 10 months annually, totalling up to 300,000 rupees over two years. Applications are processed through the National Scholarship Portal until November 30.

stories.title: Bishop’s University offers international student funding
stories.summary: Bishop’s University in Quebec is offering entrance awards and bursaries worth up to 17,000 dollars annually for international students in 2027. The institution provides more than 7 million dollars in total financial assistance each year to support undergraduate students pursuing degrees in Canada.

stories.title: Buddy4Study India Foundation scholarship details
stories.summary: The College Mentor platform provides students with access to mentors, educational content and guidance to assist with academic goals. The foundation offers scholarship information for students in Class 11 and 12, aiming to provide resources for those seeking to reach for the stars.

stories.title: Maharashtra CET Cell announces 2027 exam schedule
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell has released the tentative schedule for 2027-28 entrance exams, running from January 28 to June 10, 2027. Students will have two attempts for several courses, with the higher percentile score used for admission. The cell has doubled the number of twice-yearly tests.

stories.title: Maharashtra releases 2027 entrance exam dates
stories.summary: The State Common Entrance Test Cell has announced dates for MHT CET 2027, including exams for LLB, LLM and MBA programmes. The first round of PCB group exams begins April 8, 2027, followed by PCM group exams on April 16. Schedules are available on the official website.

stories.title: South Korea tightens exam security to prevent cheating
stories.summary: South Korean authorities are deploying 8,400 additional supervisors for college entrance exams to combat cheating. Proctors will inspect glasses and seal shirt buttons with stickers to counter the use of smart devices and artificial intelligence. Over 550,000 people are expected to participate in the event.

stories.title: NCERT to release new Class 10 textbooks by December
stories.summary: The National Council of Educational Research and Training plans to release revised Class 10 textbooks in phases starting in November 2026. The books are intended for the 2027-28 session, with language titles expected by the end of November to give schools time to adjust to curriculum changes.

stories.title: Maharashtra nursery admission age rule causes confusion
stories.summary: A new Maharashtra rule requires children to be three years old by June 30 to enter nursery, replacing the previous December 30 cut-off. The change has left parents struggling to replan schooling, with some children currently in playgroups now facing the prospect of repeating the year.

stories.title: New nursery age rule leaves children in playgroup
stories.summary: Maharashtra has revised its nursery admission age criteria, requiring children to turn three by June 30. The previous December 30 cut-off allowed younger children to enroll. The change has created confusion for parents whose children were expected to transition from playgroup to nursery this year.

stories.title: Kashmir revises school timings for winter
stories.summary: The Directorate of School Education Kashmir has revised school timings across the valley due to cold weather. Classes from nursery to Class 8 will run from 10:30 am to 2:30 pm, while classes 9 to 12 will continue until 3:30 pm. The new schedule applies to all schools.

stories.title: Kashmir schools adjust hours for cold weather
stories.summary: Authorities in the Kashmir division have notified new school timings for all institutions in response to cold conditions. Classes from nursery to 8th standard will operate from 10:30 am to 2:30 pm, while classes 9 to 12 will conclude at 3:30 pm, effective from Thursday.

stories.title: UP Board releases 2027 proposed exam centre list
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad has released the proposed examination centre list for 2027 high school and intermediate exams. The list, approved by district committees, is available on the board website. Objections from students, parents and school officials can be submitted until November 21.

stories.title: IIM Bangalore reports 92 percent attendance for UGAT
stories.summary: Over 11,000 candidates appeared for the IIM Bangalore Undergraduate Admission Test on November 15. The institute reported an overall attendance rate of 92 percent across 44 centres. Candidates can expect to view their recorded responses and provisional scores in the coming week.

stories.title: IGNOU December 2026 exam hall tickets expected soon
stories.summary: Indira Gandhi National Open University is expected to release hall tickets for the December 2026 Term-End Examinations shortly. Students can download their admit cards from the official website or the Samarth portal. The examinations are scheduled to commence on November 25, 2026.

stories.title: Federal court scraps Trump’s four-year limit on international students’ stays
stories.summary: A federal judge has vacated the Department of Homeland Security’s rule that would have capped international student visas at four years. The court ruled the policy was arbitrary and exceeded the department’s legal authority, preserving the existing duration of status framework. The government’s motion for summary judgment was denied.

stories.title: Karnataka launches AI curriculum in 1,800 government high schools
stories.summary: The Karnataka Department of School Education and Literacy has introduced an artificial intelligence curriculum for Class IX students across 1,800 government schools. The program, implemented under the National Skills Qualifications Framework, aims to provide foundational digital literacy and computational thinking skills to students through structured vocational training.

stories.title: Clemson University to launch three new degree programs in artificial intelligence
stories.summary: Clemson University will introduce bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral degrees in artificial intelligence in fall 2027. The School of Computing aims to prepare students for careers in fields including cybersecurity, health care, and finance. The university says the programs will strengthen its commitment to delivering its student experience.

stories.title: AI in German classrooms: Fighting the great dumbing down
stories.summary: Students in Germany are increasingly using AI tools to complete homework across subjects including math, physics, and languages. While some students report using the technology to explain topics and generate solutions, educators remain concerned about the impact on genuine learning and the potential for academic shortcuts.

stories.title: Doncaster school rolls out pioneering AI teaching assistant
stories.summary: Hayfield Lane Primary School in Doncaster has integrated an AI teaching assistant named Robyn into its classrooms. Originally piloted in Year 6, the tool is now being used in Years 4 and 5 to provide personalized support to pupils during class activities alongside human teachers.

stories.title: AI is entering Latin American classrooms: Are we prepared?
stories.summary: Latin American education systems are currently integrating AI despite a lack of clear policy. While 55 percent of Chilean teachers report using AI in their professional work, experts warn that students may mistake instant AI-generated answers for genuine competence and learning.

stories.title: Azercell fosters AI skills development among 100 teachers in Ganja and Khankendi
stories.summary: The Modern School with Artificial Intelligence project has completed training sessions for 100 teachers across 18 schools in Ganja and Khankendi. The initiative, which saw participation levels double the original target, focused on using AI tools to create lesson plans and integrate new technology into the classroom.

stories.title: Gemini adds full-length SAT practice exams with feedback
stories.summary: Gemini has introduced full-length SAT practice exams that provide scores and study suggestions. The tool generates questions in the official format and breaks down errors by exercise type to propose study schedules. Students are currently looking for free resources to prepare for the college admissions test.

stories.title: New York universities adjust programs for the AI era
stories.summary: The City University of New York is launching an initiative to connect education with future careers by engaging industry experts in course development. Students will gain professional skills and complete paid internships. A programming course at Baruch College is currently being taught by an engineer from Figma.

stories.title: Students want a say in AI policy
stories.summary: As generative AI becomes standard in education, students are expressing concerns about its role in the classroom. A 2025 survey found that 63 percent of students in grades six through twelve are wary of the technology. Policymakers are now considering how to include them in the conversation.

stories.title: Qatar approves 331 professional licenses for educators
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education and Higher Education has approved 331 professional licenses for teachers and school leaders. The move aims to enhance professional competencies and improve educational quality. The ministry is currently reviewing assessment results and conducting field visits to ensure these new standards are met.

stories.title: Kashmir leadership urges focus on responsible AI use
stories.summary: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has questioned how teachers can distinguish between student work and AI-assisted assignments. Rather than relying on detection tools, he has urged schools to teach responsible AI use. Teachers across the region are reporting an increase in unusually polished paragraphs in student submissions.

stories.title: Dubai schools prepare for AI-led learning models
stories.summary: Education experts in Dubai suggest that AI could make some teaching roles redundant as the technology begins to deliver lessons and answer questions. Gems Education is launching an AI-led model in January where pupils study at their own speed, moving away from traditional class-wide lesson plans.

stories.title: Teachers face ethical traps with AI detectors
stories.summary: Teachers are increasingly using AI detectors to combat cheating, despite the risk of false positives. Experts at Stanford University warn that these tools raise significant ethical questions. Educators are also navigating concerns about whether using AI to create assignments sets a poor example for their students.

stories.title: Arunachal Governor emphasizes teacher development
stories.summary: Governor K.T. Parnaik has highlighted the National Education Policy 2020, which focuses on continuous professional development and competency-based learning. Inaugurating a new training institute, he noted that the policy's objectives for holistic development can only be realized when teachers are adequately trained, motivated, and supported.

Assam to train one lakh teachers in AI
stories.summary: The Assam government is partnering with Bodhan AI to train one lakh teachers in AI-assisted lesson planning and assessment. The online programme aims to reach teachers in remote areas by May 2027. The initiative is funded by the Union education ministry and incubated at IIT-Madras.

stories.title: CBSE promotes gender equality in classrooms
stories.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education has invited students to explore themes of women's empowerment and financial independence for the 2026-27 session. The initiative encourages students to break gender stereotypes and discuss policy reforms. The themes were selected to match the age and understanding of the students.

stories.title: PEP Schoolv2 moves away from digital-first education
stories.summary: Rahul Raghavan is building a network of physical campuses as an alternative to digital-only education technology. The system aims to replace age-segregated classrooms and traditional examination cycles with a focus on academic discipline and childhood happiness. The network currently educates 500 students across five campuses in Bengaluru.

stories.title: Telangana to integrate intermediate education into schools
stories.summary: Telangana will merge its Board of Intermediate Education with the Department of School Education starting in the 2027-28 academic year. The shift ends a 55-year administrative separation between schools and junior colleges, moving toward a unified 10+2 structure with three distinct stages of primary and secondary education.

stories.title: Telangana To Move Classes 11 And 12 Into Schools From 2027-28, Ending Standalone Intermediate
stories.summary: Telangana plans to bring Intermediate education into the school system from the 2027 to 28 academic year. This would end a 55-year arrangement in which students leave school after Class 10 and join a separately run junior college. Chief Minister A. stories.title: Nigeria launches national education data infrastructure
stories.summary: The federal government has captured 34 million learners and 700,000 teachers on the Nigerian Education Data Infrastructure. The platform aims to serve as a data backbone for planning and accountability. Officials say the system will provide reliable information to support the launch of a new technology strategy.

stories.title: Army Goodwill School Bandipora gains CBSE affiliation
stories.summary: Army Goodwill School in Bandipora has transitioned from the Jammu and Kashmir Board of School Education to the Central Board of Secondary Education. The school says the move will provide students with a nationally recognised academic framework and updated teaching methods. The national board has arrived in Bandipora.

Himachal Pradesh reports 4,606 vacant lecturer posts
stories.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government reported 4,606 vacant lecturer positions across state schools in an Assembly reply. General government schools account for 3,256 of these vacancies, while government-run CBSE schools report 1,350. Computer Science currently holds the highest number of unfilled posts in the general category.

stories.title: Fiji education sector faces teacher shortages
stories.summary: Fiji's Minister for Education Aseri Radrodro says the sector is struggling with teacher shortages in specialised subjects and a reluctance among staff to serve in remote areas. The Ministry is currently working to strengthen education delivery through a new online teacher registration project.

stories.title: JKBOSE updates textbooks for six classes
stories.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Board of School Education has revised textbooks for Classes 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 11 for the 2026 to 27 session. Schools are directed to adopt the new materials to align with the National Education Policy. The list of subjects includes everything from Mathematics to

stories.title: Siblings secure civil service roles after family effort
stories.summary: Aaditya Mishra and his sister Pallavi Mishra have qualified for the IPS and IAS respectively. The siblings credit their success to a 25-year sacrifice by their father and collective family support. Individual determination is often cited, but family support can also make a difference.

stories.title: West Bengal announces job recruitment measures
stories.summary: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced a fee waiver for government recruitment exams and a two-year age relaxation starting in 2027. The state aims to generate one lakh jobs over the next five years. The measures are intended to provide relief to aspirants preparing for competitive tests.

stories.title: West Bengal waives government exam application fees
stories.summary: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that application fees for government recruitment examinations will be waived. The decision follows promises made in the BJP election manifesto. The move is intended to ease the financial burden on youths preparing for multiple competitive tests.

stories.title: Education Ministry seeks new JNU vice-chancellor
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education has invited applications for the next vice-chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University. The current tenure of Santishree Dhulipudi Pandit concludes in February 2027. Applicants are required to be distinguished academicians with at least 10 years of relevant experience.

stories.title: JNU opens applications for vice-chancellor role
stories.summary: Jawaharlal Nehru University is accepting applications for its next vice-chancellor through the SAMARTH portal until December 15. The position offers a fixed monthly salary of Rs 2,10,000 plus allowances. The university is looking for a successor to the incumbent leader.

stories.title: AICTE offers industry fellowships to faculty
stories.summary: The All India Council for Technical Education is offering a monthly fellowship of Rs 1 lakh to faculty members for one year of industry experience. The programme aims to narrow the gap between classroom teaching and industry requirements. Registrations remain open until December 15.

stories.title: IIM Bangalore receives green campus certification
stories.summary: IIM Bangalore has become the first educational institution in India to earn Platinum status under the IGBC Green Campus Rating System. The institute achieved the certification through solar capacity, wastewater recycling and sustainable operations. The campus has been officially recognised for its environmental management.

stories.title: Bharati Vidyapeeth Rabindranath Tagore School of Excellence profile
stories.summary: The Pune-based school combines an international curriculum with the teachings of Rabindranath Tagore. Established in 2017, the institution focuses on experiential education and multiple intelligences. It aims to blend global educational standards with Indian cultural values for its students.

stories.title: Suryadatta National School affiliation details
stories.summary: Suryadatta National School in Pune holds CBSE Senior Secondary affiliation valid through March 2031. The school focuses on holistic development, incorporating AI and financial literacy into its curriculum. It is currently operated by the Suryadatta Education Foundation.

stories.title: Student activists arrested in Hyderabad
stories.summary: Telangana Police arrested two student activists and detained a civil rights leader following a press conference. The group had gathered to oppose the state government's business engagements with Israeli companies. The arrests occurred during the government-hosted Bharat Summit.

research.title: Causal role of human hippocampus in relational structure learning and inference
research.summary: Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 16 November 2026, doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02627-w Pan and colleagues show that the human hippocampus represents relational structures that support inference in changing environments and provide causal evidence that disrupting hippocampal activity impairs this ability.
